solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Stair animals loved climbing

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the letters go upwards, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: pets are animals kept and loved by their owners

explanation.surface: A staircase with fond creatures making their way up it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns PETS round, upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a single stair is one tread you climb on a flight.

clue.text: Zambian leader interrupts to contradict Central American nation

indicators.note: a letter that interrupts a word breaks into it, so it sits inside the other piece

parts.note: to belie something is to contradict or give a false impression of it

indicators.note: a word's leader is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A Zambian politician cutting in to dispute something about a Latin American country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' gives Z, the first letter of Zambian; 'interrupts' puts it inside BELIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the former British Honduras is a small country on the Caribbean coast of Central America.

clue.text: Not all catch up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a trap is a device to catch something

explanation.surface: A partial attempt to draw level with someone ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses TRAP in this down entry; 'catch up' looks like a phrase meaning draw level.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a portion is some but not the whole of a thing.

clue.text: Upset, changes hotel room firstly — something in wardrobe?

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so these letters are rearranged
firstly asks for the opening letter of the word room

explanation.surface: An unhappy guest who switches hotel rooms, wondering what is in the wardrobe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' rearranges CHANGES, HOTEL and R ('room firstly'). The question mark marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the wardrobe holds garments hung on these shaped frames with hooks.

clue.text: European nations upset after vote, ultimately

indicators.note: after places the rearranged letters following the single letter
ultimately points to the final letter of the word vote
upset means thrown into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: European countries unhappy with how an election turned out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' and 'ultimately' are the signals; 'after' sets the order. 'European' alone is the definition, so 'nations' is fodder, not part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a native of the Baltic republic around Tallinn is a European.

clue.text: Ship in sea, noted

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: the Med is short for the Mediterranean Sea
Noah's Ark is the classic vessel

explanation.surface: A log entry recording that a vessel is out at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal; 'sea' is the Mediterranean, by its common short form.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something observed and remarked upon has been noticed.

clue.text: Insecure Sudan yet to rebuild

indicators.note: something still to rebuild must be put together again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fragile Sudan that has not yet been reconstructed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to rebuild' rearranges SUDAN and YET.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: anything shaky and liable to fall is not firm or safe.

clue.text: Digit has one — wrong one in the end

indicators.note: in places the jumbled word inside the other piece

parts.note: a tail is the end of something

indicators.note: wrong means not right, so the letters of one are disordered

explanation.surface: A finger or toe has a single flaw: it is wrong at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'one' belongs to the definition and the second is fodder for 'wrong'. 'Digit' means a toe here, not a numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: every toe carries a horny plate at its tip.

clue.text: Country ending in tremendous agony

indicators.note: ending in points to the final letter of the word tremendous

explanation.surface: A nation that finishes in terrible suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ending in' gives S, the last letter of tremendous.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Iberian kingdom with Madrid as capital is a country.

clue.text: Direct issue

definitions.meaning: to direct something is to aim it, as a finger or weapon
an issue is a matter under discussion, as in 'that is the crux'

explanation.surface: A straightforward matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to aim at a target, and a topic under discussion, as in 'that's not the main concern'.

clue.text: Collection of useful implements — assumed it to be about fifty

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the first pieces go around the other

parts.note: to assume a role is to take it on
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone guessing a set of handy tools amounts to about fifty pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal and 'to be' is only a link; L is the Roman numeral for fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a set of tools kept together for jobs is a kit of implements.

clue.text: Unexpected danger, eastern weapon

indicators.note: something unexpected comes out differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unforeseen threat from an eastern arm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unexpected' rearranges DANGER into GRENAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hand-thrown explosive bomb is a weapon.

clue.text: Visit daughter in decline

parts.note: to visit someone is to go to see them

explanation.surface: Calling on a daughter who is ailing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link here, though it tempts as a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a plant that runs to seed stops producing, so the phrase means to deteriorate.

clue.text: None left? I agree

definitions.meaning: playfully, nothing on the left side, so everything is on the other side

explanation.surface: Someone checking nothing remains and getting assent.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: everything is on the side opposite left, and the common phrase of assent meaning OK.

clue.text: Nation in debt is ashamed, initially

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the words debt, is and ashamed

explanation.surface: A country that is in debt and embarrassed about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes D, I and A from debt, is, ashamed; 'in' is part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the South Asian republic with Delhi as capital is a nation.

clue.text: Track opening of the bar

indicators.note: opening of asks for the first letter of the word the

parts.note: a rail is a horizontal bar

explanation.surface: Following the moment the pub opens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening of' gives T from 'the'. 'Track' is a verb meaning follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to follow a path or scent is to dog someone's footsteps.

clue.text: A line about Churchill's first agreement

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the line goes around the single letter

parts.note: a cord is a length of string or line

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of Churchill

explanation.surface: A line in a treaty about Churchill being first to agree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' gives C from Churchill; 'about' puts CORD around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a formal treaty or concord between parties is an agreement.

clue.text: Eager to welcome a European country

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so the single letter goes inside

parts.note: hungry for something is eager for it

explanation.surface: A country keen to welcome visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to welcome' puts A inside HUNGRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the central European state with Budapest as its capital.

clue.text: Queen aboard pretentious vessel

indicators.note: aboard means on board, inside, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: The monarch on board a showy ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aboard' signals the container. 'vessel' means a blood vessel, not a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tube carrying blood from the heart is a blood vessel.

clue.text: Scone: it needs cooking a bit

indicators.note: cooking the letters works them over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A baker's verdict that a scone wants more time in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs cooking' rearranges SCONE and IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a portion or segment of a whole is a piece.

clue.text: Revered symbol the Egyptians originally found in cat

indicators.note: found in means located inside, so the two letters go inside

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

indicators.note: originally asks for the opening letter of each of the words the and Egyptians

explanation.surface: Ancient Egyptians venerated cats, so a sacred emblem found in a cat fits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes T and E; 'found in' puts them inside TOM.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition: an object or animal held sacred as an emblem of a clan or group.

clue.text: Yet to be ticked off for commotion

definitions.meaning: still to be done, like an item on a list

explanation.surface: An unfinished list causing a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an item remaining on a list of tasks, and a fuss or kerfuffle.

clue.text: Elected official finally dismissed for something saucy

indicators.note: the final letter of the word is sent away

parts.note: a mayor is an elected civic official

explanation.surface: A town leader sacked at last for some risqué behaviour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally dismissed' drops R, the end of MAYOR. 'saucy' means a sauce, not cheeky.
explanation.definitionFit: Abbreviation: short for mayonnaise, a cold egg-and-oil sauce.

clue.text: This world famine needs heading off

indicators.note: heading off means removing the front letter of the word

parts.note: a dearth is a scarcity, a famine

explanation.surface: Global hunger must be headed off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs heading off' drops D from the front of DEARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: our planet is the world we live on.

clue.text: Old tree, largely hollow

parts.note: the elder is a small tree with white flowers

indicators.note: hollow means emptied out, leaving only the outside letters of the word largely

explanation.surface: An ancient tree mostly hollowed out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hollow' keeps L and Y, the outer letters of largely.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone getting on in years is aged.
